title: Implement Kit Vcs Postgres Schema
description: Implement the shared PostgreSQL schema changes for compose kit version-control and normalized metabolism snapshot persistence. Extend repo/postgres/schema.sql with kit, checkpoint, alternative, session, draft, transaction, release, snapshot, and normalized snapshot entity tables aligned with the Rust KitStore VCS model and the metabolism.kit.compose.json fixture. Update repo/postgres/README.md to document the new schema groups and design boundary. Extend an existing test file to assert the schema includes the new tables and key constraints. Do not create new test files.
summary: Implemented the compose-side PostgreSQL schema in compose/postgres/schema.sql instead of repo/postgres. Added normalized snapshot-scoped kit graph tables for families, ports, folders, files, authors, tags, concepts, qualities, benchmarks, kinds, designs, props, attributes, pieces, groups, connections, and stats, plus kit version-control tables for checkpoints, alternatives, releases, sessions, drafts, transactions, and transaction changes. Extended the existing Go test file to assert the new schema surface exists and verified the new Postgres-schema subtest passes in compose/go.
